steps: Confirmed the exact packaged app window and isolated workspace were visible in macOS Accessibility state.
Entered a disposable workspace name, project directory, and goal that explicitly forbids agent or external-service execution.
Saved the workspace in the native UI and observed the discard-changes control become disabled.
Read startup.json and verified the temporary values persisted with an empty profile list and no active job.
limitations: This save action has a foreground response and does not prove an event-only refresh path.
No slow independent read or Agent Room progress event was exercised in the packaged window.
